facts.fact: Exceptionally beautiful appearance, known as one of the Three Flowers of Gangbuk
facts.quote: 강북삼화(江北三華)로 불릴 만큼 뛰어난 용모
주화란(周和蘭)은 면사 아래로 입술을 질끈 깨물었다.

facts.fact: Beautiful eyebrows, as if drawn with a brush
facts.quote: 붓으로 그린 듯한 주화란의 아름다운 눈썹이

facts.fact: Extraordinarily beautiful; beauty beyond simple description
facts.quote: 단순히 예쁘다, 아름답다라는 말로는 주화란의 미모를 제대로 설명할 길이 없다.
큼지막한 검은 눈동자에서는 동공 지진이 일어나는 중이다.

verdict.subject: 주화란
verdict.reason: Ordinary description of her large black eyes, unchanged look.

facts.fact: Beautiful face with a cold impression
facts.quote: 검을 늘어트린 주화란은 아름다웠고, 한편으로는 차가웠다.

facts.fact: Strikingly beautiful even without any makeup
facts.quote: 다른 여인들과 달리 화장기 하나 없는 얼굴임에도 뭐라 형용할 수 없을 만한 아름다움이 흘러나왔고

facts.fact: Wears a plain, single-colored martial outfit
facts.quote: 그녀가 걸친 단조로운 색의 무복은 화려한 궁장보다 기품 있어 보였다

facts.fact: Dark blue (blue-black) eyes with a mysterious sheen

verdict.subject: 주화란
verdict.reason: Her dark blue eyes are described in the present. The passage doesn't show a change in her look.

facts.fact: Eyes curve like half-moons when smiling
Carries a sword in a scabbard at her waist
Called an old hag, but returned to youth (rejuvenated)

verdict.subject: 주화란
verdict.reason: Jeok Cheon-gang calls the silent onlooker an old hag who has returned to youth (회춘). The passage names no one, but the context points to Ju Hwaran. It announces a lasting rejuvenation.

facts.fact: Returned to youth (rejuvenated), though still called an old woman
facts.quote: 오히려 회춘하더니 눈빛이 더 기분 나빠졌어.

verdict.subject: 주화란
verdict.reason: Same line as item 2. 회춘 is stated as having happened, and 할망구 is an insult, not her actual age.

facts.fact: Underwent a body remake (rebirth of the body)

verdict.subject: 주화란
verdict.reason: Hyeok Mu-jin says she underwent 환골탈태 two days ago, and she is the one he addresses. That is a named genre transformation, so it counts as a lasting change.

facts.fact: Looks quite young for a martial artist
facts.quote: 나이도 한참 젊어 보이는 친구가 못 하는 말이 없군.

verdict.subject: Jin (the protagonist)
verdict.reason: The Taoist is talking about the speaker, a young-looking martial artist, who is the protagonist, not Ju Hwaran.
